name: SkillGraph
description: Type your skills, pick a target role, and see how ready you are, which roles fit, and what to learn next. Built from 12,872 Indian tech job postings using association rule mining (Apriori, FP-growth) and a calibrated classifier. FastAPI + React on Vercel.

paragraphs: SkillGraph maps applicant skill profiles to Indian technology roles, predicts readiness with qualitative bands, and recommends prioritized skill additions with co-occurrence companions. The system is built from 12,872 labelled Indian tech job postings, association rule mining with FP-growth, and a calibrated logistic regression classifier.
features: Readiness scoring with qualitative bands: Probability outputs pair with role top-20 skill coverage to place applicants in Ready, Close, or Not yet.
Top 3 role family matches: Softmax probabilities rank the closest career tracks from 10 calibrated role distributions.
Ranked skill gap recommendations: Counterfactual probability gains multiplied by empirical posting frequency identify the top 5 skills to learn next.
Companion skill discovery: Mined association rules surface co-occurring tools at lift >= 1.50 for combined learning.
Fast autocomplete over aliases: Prefix search indexes 800 canonical vocabulary skills and 834 synonyms from taxonomy/skillaliases.csv.
